CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2641 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ea1cde9fd3f95ab13d6d2c2e834a672af44850b5. Bus nonce: 487840aa9516e44bda1807e7548b2d63. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin ea1cde9fd3f95ab13d6d2c2e834a672af44850b5`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ea1cde9fd3f95ab13d6d2c2e834a672af44850b5` or `Fix review: blocked ea1cde9fd3f95ab13d6d2c2e834a672af44850b5 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 487840aa9516e44bda1807e7548b2d63`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2641 ea1cde9fd3f95ab13d6d2c2e834a672af44850b5") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2641-487840aa`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, PR #2641 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), roster batch 19 (roster ops, sonnet). Head ea1cde9fd3f95ab13d6d2c2e834a672af44850b5. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Check:
1. The one op (2a3d7afe8, roster_sync.py --apply) records resume.pr 2638 on R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2 and 2639 on R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY, and nothing else (three-dot diff of dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json against origin/main). Both PRs are open and their head branches match the groups.
2. Counts: 167 groups both sides, 0 new, 0 removed, 2 changed; stages unchanged (done 88, in-progress 12, not-started 60, queued 6, absorbed 1).
3. Null control: main's roster equals the merge base 3e7aaed31, so nothing main wrote is overwritten.
4. brief_lint reports 0 errors and ref_privacy --check reports 0 refused at the head. Read CI at the head from check-runs; spare the API (one bulk read).

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
